synth.notes:
Blocks move as a mirrored pair (A1/A2 y-/+4; A3 left x-4/right x+4; A4 reverse). Each block moves alone only if its target 4x4 cell is in [2,58] and not blocked by the hidden maze, a marker cell (marker xy-1) or the other block.
Clicking a marker arms the blocks (they become color_1 players and that marker turns active, color 11). In armed mode A1-4 move the active marker by 4 with the same blocking. Clicking another marker switches the active one; clicking a player disarms; other clicks do nothing.
Timer bars (wall_0 at x=64-w,y=0 and x=0,y=63) have w=3(a+1)//7, where a = actions since level start (continuity-gated). Stateless fallback: a=ceil(7w/3) when a bar is visible, else 0.
Names = type_color_rank by (y,x); ranks start at 2 in block mode (block_left/right keep their names) and at 0 in armed mode.
Step 124: maze cell (22,18) is invisible (markers at (15,11),(51,31),(7,35)). Removing it fails only step 124. The maze is still inferred: {(14,38),(6,18),(38,14),(22,18)}; unseen cells
